description: This Java class represents the description of a country in the application, extending a generic Description class and linked to the Country entity. It is annotated for persistence with JPA, including table mapping, unique constraints, and relationships. It provides constructors and getter/setter methods for the associated Country.

classes.name: CountryDescription
classes.description: Represents a country description entity, linking language and country details for multi-language support.

methods.name: CountryDescription
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the description with a language and name.
